Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Preserves PostgreSQL interval's independent month, day, and microsecond components, including mixed signs.
Equality compares storage components, rather than PostgreSQL's thirty-day-month comparison convention.

```csharp
public readonly struct PgInterval : IEquatable<PgInterval>
```

Implements: [IEquatable&lt;PgInterval&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iequatable-1)

### ToTimeSpan()

Converts an interval containing only elapsed time. Calendar months or days require a reference timestamp.

```csharp
public TimeSpan ToTimeSpan()
```

Returns: [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)

The fixed duration.

Exceptions:

- [InvalidOperationException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception): The interval is infinite or contains calendar months or days.
- [OverflowException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.overflowexception): The microseconds exceed TimeSpan's range.
